basis: Frozen manifest hashes; generated SVG export with React-equivalent theme stroke ratios
scope: Every Q–Z generated SVG export, both variants where present
summary: All 183 assigned exports were inspected individually. No hash drift. Concrete concerns: solid Save loses floppy recognition at 12–14px; Signature detail compresses at 12px; XLS/ZIP labels cannot reliably distinguish file types at 12px. Several small numerals, modifiers and dense compound icons remain uncertain and should be checked in actual interface context before approval.
